subject: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@stratavault.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratavault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing

Hi Mike / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, we want to schedule a focused security review session that brings together your security engineer, your procurement lead, and our security + SE team so we can:

- Walk through threat model & data flows for the integration
- Cover SOC2, data residency, and retention controls at a high level
- Discuss procurement checklist items (SLA, indemnity, data processing addendum)

Can you confirm which of these stakeholders will attend? Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue Aug 29, 10:30–11:30 AM
- Wed Aug 30, 2:00–3:30 PM (we can extend to 90m if needed)

Karthik (SE) and Marissa (Security) are on copy — if either slot works, we’ll circulate a calendar invite and a short pre-read (SOC2 summary + system diagram). If you need a separate procurement-only call first, let me know.

Attachments: security-session-agenda.docx (draft), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf, redwood-data-flow.png

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
——
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

From: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@stratavault.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratavault.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing

Neha —

Thanks — we’ll definitely want: our lead security engineer (me), procurement (Priya), and Carlos from infra/networking. Brief answers:

- Tue Aug 29 at 10:30 is tight for Carlos (he’s on call) but Wed Aug 30 at 2pm looks doable. We may need the full 90 minutes.
- Please include the architecture/flow diagram in the invite so Carlos can triage networking questions beforehand.
- Also, do you have a short list of docs you’ll want from us (e.g., encryption-in-transit details, SCIM/SAML expectations)?

If you want, Priya can propose alternate windows after I check Carlos’s calendar — copying her.

—Mike
Mike Johnson
Security Engineer | StrataVault Inc.
mike.johnson@stratavault.com

On Sat, Aug 25, 2028 at 09:12 Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@stratavault.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratavault.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing

Hi all —

Thanks for the summary, Neha. We’re happy to run the review and can cover the SOC2 highlights plus operational controls. A few quick asks so we can prepare the right people and artifacts:

1) Please confirm whether the session should be 60 or 90 minutes (we’ll block 90 minutes if that’s what Carlos needs).
2) Send us any specific compliance questions or the procurement checklist (if you have an itemized list Priya wants covered).
3) We’ll prepare the following pre-reads: SOC2 summary (attached), high-level data flow (attached), and a short slide on retention/KMS.

Availability from Redwood Security for next week (PST):
- Wed Aug 30: 2:00–3:30 PM (preferred)
- Thu Aug 31: 9:00–10:00 AM (backup)

I can also loop in our infra specialist if Carlos has low-level networking questions.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratavault.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@stratavault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing

Neha / team —

Thanks — Wed Aug 30 2:00–3:30 PM PST works for procurement and infrastructure. We prefer an agenda that dedicates 25–30 mins to procurement/legal items up front (SLA, DPA, liability limits) so procurement can confirm the scope before the technical deep-dive.

I’ll send a calendar hold once you share the invite with attachments. For pre-reads from our side, we’ll provide a short list: encryption-at-rest details and our expected SSO/SAML flow.

—Priya Shah
Senior Procurement Manager | StrataVault Inc.
priya.shah@stratavault.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@stratavault.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stratavault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review roundtable — aligning stakeholders & timing

Perfect — thanks for confirming. I’ll: 

- Send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 30 2:00–3:30 PM PST (90 min) titled "Redwood <> StrataVault — Security Review (technical + procurement)"
- Attach the pre-reads (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf, redwood-data-flow.png, security-session-agenda.docx)
- Add a 25–30 minute procurement block at the top of the agenda and reserve the rest for tech deep-dive

If Carlos prefers an earlier look at the diagram, I can share the PNG now — let me know. Otherwise, invite incoming in 10–15 mins so you can send a hold from your side as well.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
